title: Loi n° 2023-900 du 23 novembre 2023 portant Code de l'environnement
citation: Loi n° 2023-900 du 23 novembre 2023 portant Code de l'environnement (Journal officiel, February 2024 per the brief)
evidence: Art. 260: "La présente loi sera publiée au Journal officiel de la République de Côte d'Ivoire et exécutée comme loi de l'Etat." Signed "Fait à Abidjan, le 23 novembre 2023". No page opened states the Journal officiel publication date, so no first in-force date is read; sgg.gouv.ci, which publishes the gazette, did not open (expired certificate). Opened https://environnement.gouv.ci/uploads/publications/177332357270.pdf on 2026-11-03.
notes: Environmental framework act (76 pages). One record, dated 2023-11-23, the signature date, because a record needs a date and the act has no commencement clause; the real in-force date is the publication date. Art. 259 repeals Loi n° 96-766 du 3 octobre 1996 (predecessor, not in scope). Climate content: Art. 83 to 87 (State duties: vulnerability assessment, technology transfer, financing, and a report every three years that includes the national GHG inventories). Detailed GHG rules for the private sector sit in ci-loi-2025-528 and ci-decret-2024-658. Text extracted with pdftotext in reading order (the PDF has two columns; -layout interleaves them) and runs of spaces collapsed; the text layer is the PDF's own. The same Code is listed at https://pncc.ci/assets/documentation//IDIt6NrsRhiT44FwpEl1xFKOfUXxPt7ytTQU598C.pdf. Language: French only; English looked for on 2026-11-03 at environnement.gouv.ci (Lois et Ordonnances, Arrêtés and Décrets lists, home page language links) and pncc.ci (Textes juridiques, four pages): both publish French only; no government English text found.

title: Loi n° 2025-528 du 25 juin 2025 relative à la lutte contre les changements climatiques
citation: Loi n° 2025-528 du 25 juin 2025 relative à la lutte contre les changements climatiques
evidence: Art. 92: "La présente loi sera publiée au Journal Officiel de la République de Côte d'Ivoire et exécutée comme loi de l'Etat." Art. 91: "Les personnes physiques ou morales disposent d'un délai de trois (03) ans à compter de la publication de la présente loi pour se conformer à ses dispositions." Signed "Fait à Abidjan, le 25 juin 2025". No page opened states the publication date. Page images of the PNCC copy (pages 8 to 10, 19 and 20) read on 2026-11-03.
notes: Climate framework act (20 pages, 92 articles); the register row held it as F3, it is mapped to F2 here and its F3 content is named. Private-sector articles: Art. 19 (low-GHG development and investment strategies), Art. 20 (respect GHG emission standards and limit values of the Code de l'environnement and other regulations), Art. 21 (climate solutions in the corporate social responsibility policy), Art. 22 (contribute to GHG reduction projects and resources). Reporting and carbon-market content: Art. 12 (State builds a national MRV system), Art. 80 (State may impose verification of information by accredited independent bodies), Art. 81 (national transparency system defined by ministerial order), Art. 87 to 89 (criminal penalties for fraudulent acquisition of emission reduction titles and for destroying or sabotaging carbon or climate projects). Three-year compliance period from publication (Art. 91). title: Décret n° 2025-345 du 21 mai 2025 portant établissement d'un cadre de promotion des investissements durables et de divulgation climatique
citation: Décret n° 2025-345 du 21 mai 2025 (12 pages, 24 articles)
evidence: Art. 24: "[...] du présent décret qui sera publié au Journal Officiel de la République de Côte d'Ivoire." Art. 17: "La divulgation sur la durabilité est obligatoire à compter d'une période transitoire de deux ans, suivant la date de publication du présent décret." Signed "Fait à Abidjan, le 21 mai 2025". No page opened states the publication date. Page images of the PNCC copy (pages 1 to 3, 8, 9, 11, 12) read on 2026-11-03.
notes: Sustainability and climate disclosure framework built on a transition taxonomy. Art. 14: based on IFRS S1, IFRS S2, CSRD and regional rules. Art. 15: an annual sustainability report no later than 31 March of year n+1. Art. 16: three categories of persons in scope (1: central administrations, local authorities, listed companies and companies making a public offering; 2: companies above 250 employees or turnover above 1,000 million CFA francs, and non-profits above 500 million CFA francs of resources; 3: the smaller ones). Art. 17 and 23: transition of one, two and three years by category, category 3 voluntary (Art. 23 counts from entry into force, Art. 17 from publication; the two do not say the same). Art. 20: verification by certified sustainability firms at the promoter's cost. Art. 21: a taxonomy and disclosure monitoring unit inside the Commission nationale de lutte contre les changements climatiques created by Décret 2024-594 (F7, register row only). The brief names a Décret n° 2025-346 du 21 mai 2025 amending Décret 2024-594: no official page opened lists it (the PNCC list shows only 2025-345), so it has no entry. The PDF is a scan (one image per page) with no text layer: pdftotext returns 12 bytes, so there is nothing to store with the recipe in SOURCES.md; OCR output is not the text of the file and is not stored. title: Décret n° 2024-658 du 1er août 2024 portant création, attributions, organisation et fonctionnement du Bureau du Marché Carbone en Côte d'Ivoire
citation: Décret n° 2024-658 du 1er août 2024 (5 pages, 15 articles)
evidence: Art. 15: "[...] de l'exécution du présent décret qui sera publié au Journal Officiel de la République de Côte d'Ivoire." Signed "Fait à Abidjan, le 1er août 2024". No page opened states the publication date. Opened https://environnement.gouv.ci/uploads/publications/177332351911.pdf on 2026-11-03.
notes: Creates the Bureau du Marché Carbone (BMC) inside the Environment ministry as the single window for Côte d'Ivoire's participation in carbon mechanisms (Art. 2 and 3): a Conseil de Supervision approves carbon projects and authorises transactions (Art. 6), a Secrétariat Technique runs the Registre national carbon and a transparency framework (Art. 8). Art. 12 and 13: carbon-mechanism revenue is collected by a public accountant. Art. 14 repeals Décret n° 2012-1050 (Autorité Nationale du MDP). One record dated 2024-08-01, the signature date, because the decree has no commencement clause. The PDF carries its own OCR text layer, so the stored text keeps the OCR slips of that layer (for example "DECRET W" for "N°", "confOl1lle"). Text extracted with pdftotext in reading order, runs of spaces collapsed. Décret 2024-594 (Commission nationale, F7) is a register row only.
